basis.governing_question: How can Metalúrgica Norte cut conversion cost across its six plants in Portugal and Spain and put the improvements in place in every plant?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish the conversion cost baseline in each of the six plants and size the improvement opportunities.

gate.label: Initiatives go/no-go
gate.decision: Go or no-go on implementing the prioritized initiatives in all six plants?

phases.name: Implementation
phases.objective_one_line: Roll out the approved improvements to all six plants in waves and track conversion cost per part against the baseline.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Approve the final result: improvements running in all six plants?

architect_notes: Length is an estimate of 18-22 weeks from the archetype's typical weeks, stretched for six plants in two countries; confirm it before quoting.
No Measurement phase: the archetype tracks results inside Implementation, so confirm whether the client wants a separate post-launch tracking phase.
